verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents a Microsoft 365 Developer Program sandbox tenant, which includes an Entra ID directory, as a separate subscription and environment from production. That gives true sandbox isolation, not just a dry run. Graph Explorer also lets you test the APIs on a vendor-hosted sample tenant without signing in. missing for 10: an Entra-specific sandbox (the documented one is Microsoft-365-wide and eligibility-gated), documentation of test-data seeding or reset, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: request a Microsoft 365 E5 developer subscription to create a sandbox for developing solutions independent of their production environment
A Microsoft 365 enterprise or production subscription and a Microsoft 365 Developer Program sandbox are separate subscriptions and environments.
